tokens.title: Access Tokens
tokens.subtitle: Personal access tokens authenticate API clients, scripts, and MCP servers as you, without a browser session. Each token belongs to your account and can be revoked at any time.

usage.heading: Using a token
usage.body: Send it in the Authorization header, exactly as the API expects. A token has the same rights as your login, and its use appears in the audit log under your name.
usage.mcp: The LocalCA MCP server reads its token from the LOCALCA_PAT environment variable.

tokens.empty: No access tokens yet. Create one to let a client use the API or an MCP server.
tokens.prefixHint: Only the prefix is stored; the full token is shown once, when it is created.
tokens.revokeBody: Clients using this token lose access immediately.
tokens.revokeWarning: This cannot be undone. A replacement token is the only way to restore access.
tokens.nameHelp: A label for the client that will use it, so the audit log stays readable.

created.title: Copy your token now
created.warning: This token is shown only once. It cannot be recovered — if it is lost, revoke it and create a new one.
created.body: Save it in the client's configuration now; the server stores only its prefix.

tokens.copyFailed: Could not copy the token. Select it and copy it manually.
